title: Reading the Appraisal Register for the Figure a Valuation Rests On
content:
The figure a valuation of a traded piece rests on under the Belrose Trade-In and Upgrade Programmes is ordinarily the price the piece originally sold for. Where the Belrose Appraisal and Gemological Services register carries a value for the piece, the readings below govern.

## The rule

- Where the appraisal register carries a value for the piece from a report issued within the programme's appraisal validity window and that value stands above the price the piece originally sold for, the valuation rests instead on the highest value the register carries for the piece.
- Where the register carries a value for the piece only from a report issued longer ago than that window, the valuation rests on the value the most recent of those reports states.
- Otherwise the valuation rests on the price the piece originally sold for.

The report's age is counted in calendar days from the date the issued report for that piece was signed to the handling date, and it is within the window while that count does not exceed the window. The values the register carries for the piece are the valuations recorded against it there; where several stand, the highest is taken in the first reading and the most recent in the second.

## The window by programme

| Programme | Appraisal validity window (calendar days) |
|---|---|
| Belrose Standard Trade-In | 180 |
| Diamond Trade-Up Guarantee | 365 |
| Bridal Upgrade Guarantee | 365 |
| Lifetime Diamond Upgrade Guarantee | 365 |
| Signature Collection Upgrade Privilege | 180 |
| Estate Purchase and Consignment Programme | 180 |

## Cases on hypothetical figures

A piece that originally sold for 7000 USD, under a programme whose window is 180 calendar days.

- The issued report is 100 days old and the register carries values of 7400 and 8100 USD: the valuation rests on 8100 USD.
- The issued report is 100 days old and the register carries 6800 USD only, which is not above 7000: the valuation rests on 7000 USD.
- The issued report is 200 days old and the register's most recent value for the piece is 6600 USD: the valuation rests on 6600 USD.
- The register carries no value for the piece at all: the valuation rests on 7000 USD.
